info.title: KU-Detection-Back-End API
info.description: API for the KU-Detection-Back-End project. Includes the legacy K1-K27 detector (CodeBERT) and the new Detector17 (UnixCoder fine-tuned on 17 custom IoT/JEE/DT Knowledge Units).

tags.name: Repository Management
tags.description: Endpoints for creating, listing, and managing repositories.

tags.name: Analysis
tags.description: Endpoints for running and retrieving analysis results (legacy K1-K27 detector).

tags.name: Risk Analysis
tags.description: Endpoints for calculating knowledge and employee-related risks.

tags.name: Detector17 (17 Custom KUs)
tags.description: NEW detector trained on 17 custom Knowledge Units for IoT, JEE, and Digital Twin ecosystems: MQTT, REST_APIs, Concurrency, WebSockets, Messaging_APIs, OPC_UA, Telemetry_Data, Edge_Computing, OTA_Updates, IoT_Security, EMF, Xtext, Eclipse_RCP, Embedded_RTOS, Matter_Thread, IEC_61499, CMake. Model: UnixCoder fine-tuned (ElisavetKanidou/ku-detector-17 on Hugging Face).

post.description:
Starts analysis of a repository using the Detector17 model (UnixCoder fine-tuned on 17 custom IoT/JEE/DT Knowledge Units). Runs file-level inference on changed files per commit. Writes results to the 'analysis_results' table with ku_source='detector17' so they do not interfere with legacy K1-K27 data.

The caller SHOULD provide `commit_limit` to control how far back in git history the scan walks. Resolution order: JSON body → query string; if not provided, the full git history is analyzed. Must be an integer >= 1.

parameters.name: X-User-Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.name: repo_name
parameters.description: Name of the repository to analyze (must already exist via POST /repos).

parameters.name: commit_limit
parameters.description: Optional. Overrides the environment default. Also acceptable in the JSON body — if both are present, the body wins. Must be an integer >= 1. Omit to analyze the full history.

commit_limit.description: How many of the most recent non-merge commits to walk when extracting files for inference. Must be >= 1. Omit to analyze the full history.

message.example: Detector17 analysis started in the background.

commit_limit.description: The commit_limit actually used for this analysis.

commit_limit_source.description: 'user' if provided via body/query, 'default' if the env default was used.

400.description: Missing X-User-Organization header, or commit_limit is not an integer >= 1.

404.description: Repository not found. Create it first via POST /repos.

error.example: Repository not found. Create it first via POST /repos.

409.description: Analysis is already in progress for this repository.

get.summary: Get Detector17 analysis results for a repository
get.description: Returns all Detector17 analysis records for a given repository (filtered by ku_source='detector17' — does NOT include legacy K1-K27 data).

parameters.name: X-User-Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.name: repo_name
parameters.description: Name of the repository.

ku_labels.description: Binary labels for each of the 17 KUs (1 = detected, 0 = not detected).

ku_probabilities.description: Raw sigmoid probabilities per KU (before threshold=0.5).

404.description: Repository not found or no Detector17 results yet.

error.example: No Detector17 results found for this repository

get.summary: Get per-KU file counts for a contributor
get.description: For the given contributor in the given repository, returns the number of files where each of the 17 Detector17 KUs was detected. Used by the heatmap UI.

parameters.name: X-User-Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.name: repo_name
parameters.description: Name of the repository.

parameters.name: contributor
parameters.description: Email or name of the contributor (URL-encode special characters, e.g. '@' → '%40').

200.description: Per-KU file counts for the contributor.

ku_counts.description: Number of files where each of the 17 KUs was detected (ku_label = 1).

error.example: No records found for this contributor

delete.summary: Delete all Detector17 analysis for a repository

parameters.name: X-User-Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.name: repo_name
parameters.description: Name of the repository.

message.example: Deleted all Detector17 analysis for paho.mqtt.java

get.description: Returns the risk associated with each Detector17 KU (ku_source='detector17'). Uses the same binomial model as the legacy /ku_risk endpoint (20% departure threshold, p_individual_leave=0.1), but computed over the 17 custom IoT/JEE/DT KUs ONLY — legacy K1-K27 rows are not included.

parameters.name: X-User-Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.name: repo_name
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict the calculation to a single repository within the organization. If omitted, the risk is calculated over the entire organization.

get.description: Returns the risk associated with the hypothetical departure of each employee, considering ONLY KUs from the Detector17 taxonomy (ku_source='detector17'). Mirrors the legacy /employee_risk endpoint in shape and semantics.

parameters.name: X-User-Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.

parameters.name: repo_name
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict the calculation to a single repository within the organization. If omitted, the risk is calculated over the entire organization.

get.description: Retrieves a summary of 'knowledge skills' for the organization specified in the X-User-Organization header, computed over Detector17 KUs ONLY (ku_source='detector17'). For each of the 17 custom KUs, returns the total number of unique files and unique authors. Mirrors the legacy /organizationskills endpoint in shape and semantics.

parameters.name: X-User-Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization to filter data by.
